verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents provisioning and managing numbers at scale, a supported-countries page where certified local carriers supply numbers, and positioning for multinational businesses. For porting in other countries, it notes a template customers fill in. Nothing in the evidence shows per-country documentation or regulatory requirements stated up front when acquiring new numbers, and the actual country list is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit per-country requirements for new numbers, the list of countries where numbers can be obtained, independent corroboration of multi-country provisioning.
